description: Audit-direction decode edge (WU-15): a recorded openai/chat_completions request (system turn + function tools + a full tool round) decodes back into the canonical IR — hop 1 of the cross fixture request_openai_to_anthropic.json, pinned alone so the intermediate canonical form is golden too. The wire `model` is routing data, not canonical content (3.4): its echo rides the censused extensions['openai.model'] with an honest EXTENSIONS record; the sibling `role: tool` wire message re-threads as a canonical tool turn carrying a PartToolResult (the inverse of the encode relocation, declared); tool_calls decode to typed PartToolCalls with `arguments` kept verbatim as args_json; the knob renames run backwards (max_completion_tokens -> config.max_output_tokens) and land on the contract, not in per-call records. Same recorded input as the cross fixture, by construction.
